notes.title: v1.3 update - More languages!
notes.content:
Hey guys!

In today's update, I've added support for the following languages:

Chinese (simplified)

Spanish

Russian

Deutsch

And also fixed some bugs:

When the graphics were set on low, the walls and doors no longer flicker different colors

Some parts of the UI were not translated

notes.title: Update v1.2 - Translation and bugfixes
notes.content:
Hey guys! Today's update adds translation to the game! The languages available right now are english and brazilian portuguese, but more languages will be added tomorrow, so stay tuned!

Today's update also adresses the following issues:

Fixed a bug where the inventory UI would be broken after pausing

Made it so you can't brute force the last puzzle (vending machine)

If you have any other issues with the game, please make sure to report it on the community discussions, I am frequently checking it to see if something needs fixing.
